subject: en_read
source: English National Curriculum — English programmes of study: key stages 1 and 2 (lower KS2, Year 3), DfE 2013 — reading comprehension

weeks.topic: Retrieval: key details in a story — 'The Owl Who Was Afraid of the Dark'
objectives: Find and copy key details from a chapter
Answer who, what, where and when questions

weeks.topic: Prediction from cover, title and blurb — adventure stories
objectives: Predict what might happen using the cover and blurb
Check and change predictions while reading

weeks.topic: Inference: characters' feelings — 'The Hodgeheg' (Dick King-Smith)
objectives: Infer characters' feelings from their actions and words
Support inferences with evidence from the text

weeks.topic: Vocabulary in context: animal stories — 'Charlotte's Web' (E. B. White)
objectives: Work out the meaning of new words from context
Check meanings in a dictionary

weeks.topic: Sequencing and summarising chapters — 'Charlotte's Web'
objectives: Order the main events of a chapter
Summarise a chapter in a few sentences

weeks.topic: Fairy tales: comparing versions of a traditional tale
objectives: Compare two versions of the same fairy tale
Identify typical fairy-tale features

weeks.topic: Non-fiction: contents, index and glossary
objectives: Use contents pages and indexes to find information
Use a glossary to check technical words

weeks.topic: Non-chronological reports: main ideas in paragraphs — dinosaurs
objectives: Identify the main idea of each paragraph
Retrieve facts from a report about dinosaurs

weeks.topic: Poetry: rhythm, rhyme and performance
objectives: Prepare a poem to read aloud with intonation
Discuss how rhythm and rhyme affect the reader

weeks.topic: Greek myths: Theseus and the Minotaur and Pandora's box
objectives: Identify features of myths
Discuss the hero's qualities and choices

weeks.topic: Figurative language — 'The Iron Man' (Ted Hughes)
objectives: Find similes and powerful verbs in the text
Explain how language creates a picture

weeks.topic: Inference with evidence — 'The Iron Man'
objectives: Infer what characters think and want
Justify answers with quotations

weeks.topic: Instructions and explanations: features and purpose
objectives: Identify the features of instructions and explanations
Explain how each text helps the reader

weeks.topic: Mystery stories: asking questions to understand
objectives: Ask questions before, during and after reading
Track clues to solve a mystery

weeks.topic: Review: retrieval, inference and prediction
objectives: Practise retrieval and inference questions on an unseen text
Revise vocabulary and summary skills

weeks.topic: Fables: identifying the moral — Aesop's fables
objectives: Identify the moral of a fable
Compare characters across several fables

weeks.topic: Stories from other cultures: Anansi tales
objectives: Discuss how the setting reflects a culture
Identify the trickster character's traits

weeks.topic: Shape poems and calligrams: how layout adds meaning
objectives: Explain how layout and shape add meaning
Compare a shape poem with a traditional poem

weeks.topic: Playscripts: reading aloud with expression
objectives: Recognise the features of a playscript
Read a part aloud using stage directions

weeks.topic: Character traits with evidence — 'Fantastic Mr Fox' (Roald Dahl)
objectives: Describe characters' traits using evidence
Compare Mr Fox with the three farmers

weeks.topic: Author study: Roald Dahl's invented words and humour
objectives: Identify invented words and their meanings
Explain how the author makes readers laugh

weeks.topic: Newspaper articles: fact and opinion
objectives: Distinguish facts from opinions in articles
Identify headline, opening and quotations

weeks.topic: Biography: the life of a significant person
objectives: Retrieve key events from a biography
Place events on a timeline

weeks.topic: Legends: Robin Hood and King Arthur
objectives: Identify features of legends
Discuss what makes a legendary hero

weeks.topic: Comparing two information texts on rainforests
objectives: Compare how two texts present the same topic
Decide which text is more useful and why

weeks.topic: Settings and atmosphere — 'Stig of the Dump' (Clive King)
objectives: Explain how the author describes the setting
Discuss how the setting creates atmosphere

weeks.topic: Reading comprehension assessment: Terms 1 and 2
objectives: Answer retrieval, vocabulary and inference questions
Explain answers with evidence from the text

weeks.topic: Persuasive texts: adverts and leaflets
objectives: Identify persuasive techniques in adverts
Explain how images and words persuade

weeks.topic: Nature poetry and haiku: imagery
objectives: Find imagery in nature poems
Discuss how syllable patterns shape a haiku

weeks.topic: Adventure stories: how authors build tension
objectives: Identify how short sentences and cliffhangers build tension
Predict what happens next with reasons

weeks.topic: Letters in stories — 'Dear Greenpeace' (Simon James)
objectives: Read a story told through letters
Infer the characters' viewpoints from their letters

weeks.topic: Themes: friendship and kindness across stories
objectives: Identify a theme shared by two stories
Compare how characters show friendship

weeks.topic: Retrieval from maps, charts and timetables
objectives: Retrieve information from maps, charts and timetables
Answer questions using several sources

weeks.topic: Book reviews: giving opinions about books
objectives: Read and discuss book reviews
Recommend a book giving reasons

weeks.topic: Reading for pleasure: choosing and discussing books
objectives: Choose a book independently and keep a reading journal
Discuss favourite authors with others

weeks.topic: End-of-year reading assessment: Year 3
objectives: Answer comprehension questions on fiction and non-fiction
Use evidence to support answers

weeks.topic: Review and summer reading plan
objectives: Reflect on reading progress
Plan a summer reading list
